name: DCA Cozy Cone Motel (Cone 3) Creamy Bacon Mac 'n' Cheese in a Warm Bread Cone
brandOrRestaurant: Cozy Cone Motel (Cars Land · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: bacon mac n cheese cone dca
whyItWorks: Soft spiral pasta in cheddar cheese sauce tucked inside a warm, soft-baked white bread cone—completely free of spicy peppers or raw vegetables (unlike the Chili Cone Queso next door).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bacon Mac 'n' Cheese Cone (you can also ask for no bacon crumbles) and take 1–2 lactase enzyme tablets before eating.
watchOuts: Avoid the Chili Cone Queso (beans + chili spice + Fritos) and take lactase for the cheese sauce
